description: Crafting and technology centered around totems
body:
# ⚡ Totem Expansion Craft

**Author: Tea_Leaf_Fox / 茶叶狐**

Expands on the vanilla Totem of Undying by adding multiple totems with unique effects, blending magic and technology for a fresh survival experience. The mod currently features **9 distinct totems**, with more in development.

---

## 🔮 Features & Why Download

Here are all the totems currently included in the mod and their powerful effects:

1. **🏗️ Building Totem** – Spawns a custom structure and summons 3 Iron Golems upon death, turning defeat into victory.
2. **💥 Creeper Totem** – Creates an explosion on death while granting you immunity and fall protection. Clear mobs or use as a living bomb.
3. **💚 Heal Totem** – Revives you with full health and grants multiple powerful buffs, greatly enhancing survivability.
4. **🌀 Teleport Totem** – Right-click a block to bind a location. On death, you will be teleported back to that spot. Say goodbye to corpse runs.
5. **👑 Supreme Totem** – Grants 30 seconds of overwhelming strength and resistance upon death. Experience true power.
6. **⚡ Lightning Totem** – Summons continuous lightning strikes around you for 30 seconds after death, devastating nearby mobs.
7. **🎰 Gamble Totem** – A life-or-death gamble. 50% chance to gain powerful buffs and Iron Golem bodyguards; 50% chance to suffer debuffs and be ambushed by monsters, with a 1% hidden surprise.
8. **☢️ TianDi TongShou Totem** – Initiates a slowly expanding spherical destruction field that instantly kills all entities within, the ultimate doomsday weapon.
9. **🕳️ Void Totem** – Automatically triggers when you fall into the void, teleporting you back to safety. Your final insurance.

---

## ⚙️ How to Get Totems

All totems can be crafted at a crafting table using specific materials. Some can also be found as rare loot in the chests of vanilla structures such as Desert Temples, Pillager Outposts, End Cities, and more!

---

## 📥 Installation & Compatibility

- **Requirement**: This mod requires **Fabric API** to run.
- **Version**: Currently supports **Minecraft 1.21.11** only.
- **Important**: Please ensure you have the latest version of Fabric API installed, or the game will not launch.
